description: This Java source file defines a class 'ThingMongoEventAdapter' that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface. It provides functionality to serialize and deserialize events related to 'things' in a persistence context, converting between event objects and MongoDB BSON representations. The class includes migration logic for evolving event data schema and manages mappings for custom event types, especially regarding modified and created event versions.
